name: microplate_layouts_benchmark
description: This record preserves a frozen snapshot of microplate_layouts_benchmark, a configurable Python benchmark for evaluating microplate layouts under simulated spatial disturbances. It supports dose-response and high-throughput screening experiments on 384-well plates using synthetic signals with known ground truth. The reference configuration compares randomized layouts, PLAID layouts, and two versions of COMPD layouts. Disturbance scenarios include bowl-shaped effects, right-half column gradients, row gradients, and alternating-row stripes. Evaluation covers dose-response curve fitting and potency estimation, control-quality metrics, and screening activity discrimination. The archive contains the benchmark source code, layout and disturbance configuration files, reference layout files, repository documentation, and a generated PDF report presenting the benchmark results. Layout generation is separate from benchmark execution; additional layout families can be evaluated when they satisfy the documented input contract. The included README.md provides detailed specifications of the layout encoding, default configurations, disturbance scenarios, software requirements, execution stages, and output-generation workflow. The complete generated simulation CSV datasets are not included. They can be regenerated using the archived code and inputs. This snapshot was prepared for an accompanying manuscript describing the benchmark.
